pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/useGeneration.ts:65 These React hooks only hand a finished CLITask to useModuleCLI or call app/UE HTTP endpoints, so none of them puts together a hook chain, loads extensions or keeps checkpoints. A search of src/hooks (and all of src) for subagent, hookChain, wrapToolCall, PreToolUse and loadExtension found nothing, and the 'plugin' hits are the UE5 PofBridge editor plugin, not runtime extensions.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/useGeneration.ts:48 The hook keys a top-level CLI session per entity; it never starts a run from inside another run.
src/hooks/useBlueprintTranspiler.ts:77 This joins duplicate in-flight HTTP transpile requests. It is not mid-loop user input to an agent, so the technique's precondition is absent.
